events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The rider cancelled this RydeX booking, so the fee can only stand through NS-0's rider branch, i.e. NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. On NS-4 an immediate booking cancelled within 3 minutes of matching is not chargeable, and the rider cancelled 175 seconds (2 min 55 s) after acceptance, which is ≤ 3:00 [F2][NS-4]. The fee therefore fails its own condition; the $6.61 cancellation fee charged on record [F5] must be returned in full.

The fee cannot be salvaged through the no-show path either. NS-0 routes a no-show only through `cancelled_by = driver`, and here the cancellation was by the rider [F2][NS-0]. In any event the driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F4], the platform never recorded the driver at the pickup point [F3], and the driver's closest approach was 1685 m, never within 200 m [F1] — none of the NS-1 elements (i)-(iii) could be satisfied, so NS-2's refund logic applies by analogy to the fee already collected [F1][F3][F4][NS-1][NS-2].

No basis exists to reduce or partially offset the amount: surge was 1.0× with no multiplier applied [F6], and the fare record shows only the single disputed cancellation fee of $6.61, so the sum returned is exactly 6.61 [F5][F6][FARE-1][NS-7].

The driver's post-trip statement that he "was on his way" [F10] is a statement, not a system record, and does not override the GPS and timeline showing the driver 1685 m away and never having pressed "I'm Here" [F1][F4]. No safety issue appears: the two chat messages are a rider asking for ETA and the driver answering "about 5 min, traffic", and the complaint is purely about the fee — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F7][F8][F9][F10][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

On the interpretation question left to me (SAFE-1), the chat, statement and complaint contain no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation, so the screen returns "none" [F7][F8][F9][F10][SAFE-1]. The dispute type is no-show, not safety, so no escalation is required on that ground.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news — your cancellation fee has been refunded in full.

You cancelled your RydeX ride 2 minutes 55 seconds after you were matched with a driver. Because that is under three minutes, the fee should never have been charged, so we're reversing the $6.61.

The $6.61 comes to you as a Ryde voucher, added to your account. Nothing else changes: no flag on your account, and no action needed from you.

Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the mix-up.

DRIVER: Heads up about a recent RydeX booking — we reversed the rider's $6.61 cancellation fee.

The rider cancelled less than three minutes after being matched, and a fare cancelled that quickly isn't chargeable. Your statement said you were on the way, but we couldn't match it to the trip records, so the fee couldn't stand. No safety concern was raised by either side.

The $6.61 was returned to the rider as a Ryde voucher. This is not a mark against you — no account flag was applied and your account stays in good standing. Payouts and future trips are unaffected.

Questions? Get in touch through the app.
